name: Sales Manager & Scheduler For WooCommerce
author: wppforeveryone

sections.description:
Take control of your WooCommerce sales with ease!
Sales Manager & Scheduler for WooCommerce is the ultimate tool for setting up, managing, and automating sales campaigns. Whether you’re running seasonal promotions, flash sales, or long-term discounts, this plugin streamlines the entire process, saving you time and boosting revenue.

Key Features:

  • Schedule Sales in Advance – Set sales for specific time frames, ensuring smooth automated execution.
  • Bulk Pricing Management – Apply discounts to multiple products at once, making price adjustments easy.
  • Category-Specific Discounts – Assign discounts to entire product categories effortlessly.
  • Individual Product Pricing – Customize discounts for specific products to maximize conversions.

Upcoming Features:

  • Countdown Timer
  • Sales Dashboard
  • Labels & badges
  • Much much more in advance…

💡 Boost your WooCommerce revenue with effortless sales automation!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Sales Manager to configure your sales settings.
  4. Create and schedule your sales effortlessly!
sections.faq:
How does the sales scheduling work?

Simply set the start and end date for your sales. The plugin will automatically apply and remove the discount at the right time.

Can I apply bulk discounts?

Yes! The plugin allows you to apply sales to multiple products and categories in one click.
